# Why won't my bank statement CSV import into Xero?

> Free Xero bank statement CSV checker: finds why a statement will not import or imports with wrong dates (rows above the header, separate Debit/Credit columns, bad amounts, mixed date order, repeats), with line numbers, and writes a repaired CSV. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
